continents.name: The Antecedent Isles
continents.subtitle: Logic, computability and the mathematical prehistory of AI, 1666–1942
continents.border_west: open ocean; Leibniz 1666 is the westernmost isle (research/01 "Open questions": a single "Myths & Automata" islet at most further west)
continents.border_east: 1943 coastline; Turing 1936 isle "drawn with a causeway to the shore" (research/01 split table)

continents.name: The Cybernetic Shore
continents.subtitle: Cybernetics, neural modelling and the first thinking-machine programmes, 1943–1956
continents.border_east: "the 1955–56 delta (Dartmouth proposal)" where the Hilbert–Gödel–Turing and Wiener–McCulloch rivers meet (research/01 map notes)

continents.name: The Symbolic Heartland
continents.subtitle: Dartmouth and the golden age of symbolic AI, 1956–1974
continents.border_east: "a cliff/escarpment labelled 'First AI Winter (1974)' with three marked passes: Lighthill (UK), Mansfield/DARPA (US), and ALPAC" (research/02 map notes)

continents.name: The Winter Steppes
continents.subtitle: The two AI winters — funding collapse and retrenchment, 1974–1993
continents.border_west: First Winter escarpment 1974 (research/03 map notes: "1974–1980 in the west … frozen ground")
continents.border_east: "The eastern border (~1993) is a fog bank rather than a cliff — the field does not end, it renames itself" (research/03); second frozen band "1987–1993 in the east"

continents.name: The Expert Systems Plateau
continents.subtitle: Knowledge engineering, expert systems and the Fifth Generation boom, 1980–1993
continents.border_west: XCON/R1 1980 — "the expert-systems boom lies between [the two winters] as a warm valley" (research/03 map notes)
continents.border_east: "Lisp Machine Crash 1987" / second winter; fades into the 1993 fog bank

continents.name: The Connectionist Revival
continents.subtitle: Hopfield nets, backpropagation and the PDP era of neural networks, 1982–1998
continents.border_west: Hopfield 1982; "the 'Backprop Pass' (1986) reconnects the connectionist south to the mainstream" (research/03); "the Fodor–Pylyshyn river (1988) separates this continent from the symbolic/expert-systems landmass" (research/04)
continents.border_east: "LSTM (1997) and LeNet-5 (1998) are the last high ground before the deep-learning continent"; "a wide statistical-learning strait … partially submerges connectionism in the mid-1990s" (research/04)

continents.name: The Statistical Isthmus
continents.subtitle: Probabilistic, Bayesian and statistical machine learning, 1988–2011
continents.border_west: Pearl 1988 — "a new Probability River (Pearl) begins to flow east" (research/03); "a broad isthmus connecting era 03 (north-west) and era 04 (south-west) to era 06 (east)" (research/05)
continents.border_east: ILSVRC 2012 fault line (shared with the basin; research/06)

continents.name: The Deep Learning Basin
continents.subtitle: GPU-trained deep neural networks from DBNs to AlphaGo, 2006–2017
continents.border_west: "the ILSVRC 2012 fault line — SVM-plus-hand-crafted-features on one side, learned features on the other — with the 2006 DBN papers as the foothills that precede it" (research/06)
continents.border_east: "the Attention River … leaves the map eastward at Vaswani 2017" (research/06); 12 June 2017

continents.name: The Transformer Plateau
continents.subtitle: Attention, pre-trained language models and scaling laws, 2017–2022
continents.border_east: "the RLHF canal (2017 preferences paper → InstructGPT 2022) is the crossing into the chatbot era" (research/07); ChatGPT 30 Nov 2022

continents.name: The Generative Coast
continents.subtitle: Chat assistants, open-weight models, reasoning models and agents, 2022–present
continents.border_west: "Draw the western border at 30 Nov 2022 (ChatGPT)" (research/08 map notes)
continents.border_east: "an open coastline dated Sept 2026 with a 'here be dragons' strip east of the last triangulated rows" (research/08); east edge = last completed month (AXES.md §1)
